root_cause: FanDuel event-page details are fetched sequentially for every verified game on a full CFB slate, so one slow provider can block Page 1 for many timeout windows.

Alternate and ladder FanDuel player-prop markets contain the same canonical stat aliases as main markets and can be emitted into the canonical merge key, allowing a non-main threshold to displace the intended line.
implementation: fetch verified FanDuel event-page details with bounded parallelism so the slate degrades within one bounded request window instead of one timeout per game
reject alternate, alt, ladder, and milestone market families before canonical stat alias matching
preserve exact verified-game binding, canonical player extraction, nested American price parsing, and sportsbook projection influence 0.0
